Traditional Sauna Ritual

A SAUNA RITUAL is a sauna visit led by a professional sauna master – for one, for two or for a larger group. Unwind completely and discover new sensations.

"Bathe in the sauna with a fresh birch whisk, and your body will stay white."

  • Led by Certified Sauna Masters
  • Relaxing Herbal Hot Tubs with the Healing Power of Nature
  • A Refreshing Pond All Year Round

The Full Sauna Ritual

Seven steps that bring together traditional Latvian sauna practice and our sauna masters' own touch.

Warming in the Herbal Hot Tub

The ritual begins in a gently warm herbal hot tub that prepares body and mind for the sauna. Fragrant herbs help you relax and let go of everyday stress.

Herbal Tea

Warm medicinal herbal tea, rich in natural vitamins and minerals, readies the body for the steps ahead.

Whisking

Whisking is the heart of the sauna ritual. The sauna master works over the body with steamed birch, oak and other leafy whisks – fanning hot steam, pressing and gently patting – to bring deep relaxation, stimulate circulation and cleanse the skin.

Herbal Scrub

A scrub of medicinal herbs and salt gently removes dead skin cells and leaves the skin renewed.

Warm Honey Massage

Warm honey is massaged into the skin to moisturise it deeply, leaving it soft, clear and glowing. It calms the mind as well.

A Dip in the Cool Pond

After the whisking, the sauna master leads you to the cool pond for a dip. The cold water cools the skin and invigorates the circulation.

Resting in Warm Blankets

After the hot-and-cold contrast, you are wrapped in warm blankets to rest in the fresh air. This quiet rest settles the circulation and closes the ritual in complete peace.
